name: Vazirmatn
description: De-facto modern standard for Persian typography. Started 2015 as Vazir, renamed 2022. Default Persian font in Fedora.
notes: All weights other than Thin, Regular, and Black are generated by interpolation. 9 weights + variable font.

name: Vazir (Legacy)
description: Original Vazir font (2015-2022), superseded by Vazirmatn. Archived but still usable.
commercial_free: Archived repository. Use Vazirmatn for new projects.

name: Sahel
style: Open, friendly, based on DejaVu Sans
description: Friendly open-source UI alternative with Farsi-Digits variant (Sahel-FD) where Latin digits are replaced with Persian numerals.
notes: Includes Sahel-FD variant for Persian numerals. 3 static weights + variable font.

name: Samim
description: Rounded humanist sans-serif, discontinued/archived August 2022.
commercial_free: Archived August 2022. Still usable under OFL. Use Vazirmatn or Sahel for new projects.

name: Estedad
description: Rising star for bilingual UI. Screen-optimized Arabic-Latin sans with full variable font support.
notes: Excellent for bilingual Arabic/Latin projects. 9 weights + variable font.

name: Shabnam
description: Clean humanist sans-serif, discontinued/archived August 2022.
license: Archived August 2022. Still usable under OFL.

name: Tanha
style: Single-weight display sans, based on Samim/Vazir
description: Single-weight display font based on Samim/Vazir, archived August 2022.

name: Gandom
description: Serif font based on Noto Serif, archived August 2022.
license: Archived August 2022. Still usable under OFL.

name: Parastoo
description: Refined modern Persian sans-serif, good for print and digital body text.
commercial_free: Available on Google Fonts. 2 weights (Regular, Bold).

name: Lalezar
style: Bold decorative, vintage Persian poster style
description: Bold decorative display typeface with vintage Persian poster aesthetic. Designed by Borna Izadpanah.
commercial_free: Inherently bold weight. Great for display/headlines.

name: Noto Naskh Arabic
description: Traditional Naskh style, screen-optimized. Default on Android/ChromeOS for Arabic script.
commercial_free: 4 weights (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold). Part of Google Noto family.

name: Noto Sans Arabic
description: Neutral UI sans for multilingual interfaces. 1,642 glyphs. Part of Google Noto family.
notes: 9 weights + variable font. Excellent for multilingual projects.

name: Noto Kufi Arabic
description: Geometric Kufic style, modern and clean. Good for headings and signage.
notes: 9 weights + variable font. Kufic display style.

name: Amiri
description: Revival of early 20th-century metal type. Closest free font to traditional manuscript Naskh. Widely used for Quranic text.
commercial_free: 4 files (Regular, Bold + matching Italics). Amiri Quran variant available for Quranic text.

name: Markazi Text
style: Open, clear Naskh with compact stance
description: Open, clear Naskh with compact stance. Good for body text in books and magazines.

name: Gulzar
description: Contemporary Nasta'liq with Latin support. Designed for Urdu/Persian literary reading.

name: Baloo Bhaijaan 2
description: Rounded, playful display font. Variable font with multiple weights.

name: IRANSans
description: Commercial standard in Iran. Most widely deployed commercial Persian sans. Used across corporate websites, government portals, publishing.
farsi_digits_variant: corporate UI;e-commerce;long-form Persian body text;government portals
license: Paid commercial license required. npm wrapper only provides CSS plumbing, not font files. Variants: IRANSansX, IRANSansFN, etc.

name: IranNastaliq
description: Cascading calligraphic Nasta'liq. Originally sponsored by Iran's Supreme Council of ICT. Freely distributed.
sources_other: No Latin support. Pure Nasta'liq for Persian/Urdu calligraphy.

name: Tahrir
style: Iranian-Arabic Naskh hybrid, optimized gray texture
description: Iranian-Arabic Naskh hybrid optimized for newspaper/text gray texture. v4.3 has 6 weights.

name: Nazanin (B Nazanin)
description: Traditional Persian display serif. Legacy font from Borna Rayaneh. Culturally embedded in Iranian print/gov docs.
license: Traditionally free for personal use. Verify commercial licensing per source.

name: Lotus (B Lotus)
description: Compact calligraphic ornamental display font from Borna Rayaneh.
license: Traditionally free for personal use. Verify commercial licensing.

name: Titr (B Titr)
description: Heavy bold headline font from Borna Rayaneh. Classic Persian display.
license: Single weight (Bold). Traditionally free for personal use.

name: Yekan (B Yekan)
description: Calm modern sans with rounded movement. Legacy Borna Rayaneh font.
license: Traditionally free for personal use. Verify commercial licensing.

name: Iranian Sans
description: Open-source Persian sans-serif font. Available on Font Library.
